data.name: label4.Text
data.value:
Career opportunities for BS Entrepreneurship graduates encompass a wide range of possibilities in the business world. Graduates can start their own businesses or join startups in various industries, applying their entrepreneurial skills to innovate and create new ventures. They can work in business development, marketing, sales, and operations management roles within startups or established companies.
Entrepreneurship graduates can also pursue careers in venture capital firms, consulting agencies, and business incubators, providing guidance and support to emerging businesses. Additionally, they may explore opportunities in social entrepreneurship, focusing on creating positive social impact through business initiatives.

data.name: label2.Text
data.value: The Bachelor of Science in Entrepreneurship (BS Entrep) is a four-year course designed to provide undergraduate students an in-depth understanding and appreciation of new venture operations in small business enterprises. It aims to equip young students with entrepreneurial spirit to realize a vibrant and developing economy in the hands of the Filipinos and develop desirable qualities of leadership, social concern and moral values among them.
